paite: Zingchiang thu ah ki- uangsak ke'n; ni in bang hon suahpih ding ahia chih lah na thei ngal kei a.
Midang in nang hon phat uhen, nangmah mah kam hilou in; mikhual in nangmah mah mukte hilou in.
Suang agik a, piaunel agik hi; himahleh mihai lungzinna huaite gel sang in agikzaw hi.
Thangpaihna agilou, hehna akhel; himahleh thikna ma ah kua adingh thei dia?
Aguk a itna sang in alangtang a salhna ahoihzaw.
Lawm khat liamnate ginom ahi ua, himahleh melma hon tawpna khemna ahi.
Kha gilvah in khuaikhak achimtak a; himahleh kha gilkial a ding in thil kha chiteng akhum hi.
Abuk a kipan a vasa vakvai bang in, huai bang in amun a kipan mi avakvai hi.
Nuh theih leh gimnamtui in lungtang akipaksak a; huai bangmah in mihing lawm khumna lungsimtak a thupha a hong pai ahi.
Na lawm mahmah, na pa lawm mangngilh ke'n; na tuahsiatna ni in na unau inn ah hoh ke'n; gamlapi a-unau sang in inveng nai om ahoihzaw hi.
Ka tapa, pil in, ka lungtang kipaksak in, kei hon taite ka dawntheihna ding in.
Mipilvang in hoih lou amu a, abu hi; himahleh mimawl in a- awlmoh kei a, athuakloh hi.
Mikhual a ding moh khu dia om puansilh la in; huan numei lamdang a dia moh khu dia om chiamkhamna ding in len in.
Kuapeuh aw ngaihtaka, zingsang beltak a thou a, a-inveng vualzawl, ama a ding in hamsia a sim ahi ding hi.
Vuahchiin ni a vuah zu leh numei kinak hat akibang.
Kuapeuh amah khou huih khou bang ahi a, khut taklam a sathau ham bang ahi.
Sik in sik ahiamsak bang in mihing in alawm mel ahiamsak hi.
Kuapeuh theipi kung kem in huai a agah ane ding; huan kuapeuh apu ngak zahtak in a-om ding hi.
Tui a maitang in maitang amuh bang in, huai mah bang in mihing lungsim ah mihinna akimu hi.
Sheol leh Abaddon alungkim ngei kei ua, huan mihing mitte alungkim ngei kei uh.
Huansianna bel dangka a ding ahi, huan meipi dangka-eng a ding, huchibang mah in mihing phatna a ze-et in a-om hi.
Mihai sum sung ah buh taisate lak ah suk in su mah lechin, huchipi in leng amah a kipan in ahaina apaimang kei lai ding hi.
Na belamhonte omdan thei ding in thanuam in, na ganhonte hoihtak in en in;
Hauhsaknate tangtawn a ding ahi kei a; lallukhu in suan tengteng adaih zou hia?
Buhpawl puak in a-om a, huan loupa nou akilang, mualte a loupate akilakhawm hi.
Belamnoute'n na puansilh ding ahon pe ding, huan kelte'n na lou man ding.
Huan na an ding in, na inkote an ding in kel nawitui kiching a-om ding hi; huan na nungakte vakna ding in.
